# Monetary survivor case 2

Public records retained after the guardian stop/join, fresh reissuance and withdrawal, Core confirmation, and restart/catch-up acknowledgements. Driver assertion files are not themselves proof: the dedicated offline test verifies certificates, witness signer identities, monetary amounts, and restored guardian signing shares. The block RPC capture is subsequent read-only retrieval; the transaction/mempool observations retain their original capture times. No tokens, private nonce keys, client databases or credentials are copied.
